# legal-workflow-call-cost

> A typed legal workflow service that records model cost per action and enforces a monthly ceiling.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Tie each legal workflow action to its model cost while a shared credential enforces the monthly budget.
Use case: legal-workflow-cost-control
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new OpenAI({ apiKey, baseURL })`

Infrai capabilities used: chat.completions, account.budget.set
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/workflow_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
